body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and push it 1 unit away from a chosen willing creature, which may be you.

surges.html: The target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn on a hit.

rider.title: Authority - Example
rider.html: Spend this Authority when the target next approaches the chosen creature before your next turn: that creature gains +1 Fortitude against the target's next attack.
